free_tier.stated: no permanent free tier: "We don't offer a permanent free tier. After your trial, pick a paid plan to keep reviewing." quoted, and the docs say "Every workspace begins with a 14-day free trial starting at signup"

retention.stated: 14 days then zero, so the review capacity vanishes rather than shrinking.

interface_detail: Git: Qodo is installed in the user's Git provider and reviews pull requests (docs.qodo.ai, Git code review and Install Qodo in your Git provider); the pricing page also lists IDE integrations.
tooling: the Qodo app installed in a Git provider, and the Qodo Agentic Toolbox, a CLI documented at docs.qodo.ai/agentic-toolbox.
chaining: the trial is a 14-day instrument for measuring a review pipeline on real pull request volume, and it pairs with a free repository host; nothing survives past day 14.

identity_cost.detail: no card: the pricing FAQ describes the 14-day Pro Team trial as 'unlimited reviews and no credit card', so no payment method is taken and no hold exists. The trial starts at signup - 'Every workspace begins with a 14-day free trial starting at signup' - and 'When the trial ends, usage stops unless a paid billing setup is active'. The signup form's own fields are not described, so whether an email, phone number or ID document is required is unknown; kind kept as email without an evidence row stating it.

evidence.proved: "We don't offer a permanent free tier. After your trial, pick a paid plan to keep reviewing." quoted from the pricing FAQ; Pro Team is a 14-day trial with unlimited reviews and no credit card
"Every workspace begins with a 14-day free trial starting at signup. This is the universal entry point into Qodo." and "When the trial ends, usage stops unless a paid billing setup is active." quoted
the paid unit is a credit at "$.012/credit, pooled across the team" in 2,500 / 5,000 / 20,000 packs, advertised as about 18 / 36 / 144 reviews a month
Pro Team includes git and IDE integrations
the provider documents Git code review on pull requests
evidence.quote: Automated AI review on every pull request, with bugs, standards, and context-aware feedback.

evidence.proved: the provider documents a CLI-powered Agentic Toolbox
evidence.quote: A CLI-powered quality counterpart for coding agents.

notes: The free Developer tier with 250 credits and 30 PR reviews a month is still repeated by review sites; the vendor page and its docs both say it does not exist. That claim is false. One free route remains and it is gated: the pricing FAQ says "Qualified open source projects can apply to the Qodo for Open Source program for free access", which is an application that must be approved, not a signup.
